# CRITERION UNCHANGED, COUNT EARNED 2026-09-22 coo, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1124, chunk C of the standing chop): safe-points.unpolled 95 -> 84, polled 158 -> 169, partially_polled 0 on both arms and the identity holding. ⛔ RE-MEASURED AFTER THE REBASE AND NOT COMPUTED, because the baton's condition FOUR says a baseline proven before a rebase is void: this row was first proven as 104 -> 93 against SCRIP fa1dc84a5, then 07f0ab2ba (+3 Icon range-generator sites) and d9a11dd63 (chunk A sub-batch 1, +6 scan-spine sites) landed under it and took the base to 95, and the rebased tree was rebuilt and re-read to 84. The 11 sites this landing credits are the same 11 either way, but the number was taken from the instrument on the rebased tree rather than by arithmetic on the old one. THE FRAME AND VOID FAMILY, 17 of the chunk's 21 sites, at 11 insertion points, all ONE form: a bare x86_rt_gc_poll() placed IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE CALL AND INSIDE the push/align envelope, before the pops. ⭐ THE PLACEMENT IS MEASURED, NOT COPIED: gc_slot_reg tests gc_blk_of on every word, so the sweep from the seam floor is CONSERVATIVE, and rt_gc_poll_slow sets its floor at rsp+88, ABOVE its own nine pushes and the r13 slot of the cfo's fa1dc84a5. A value SPILLED ON THE STACK above that floor is found and relocated; a value live only in a REGISTER is not, r13 excepted by the probe. So the poll inside the envelope roots the caller's rax:rdx for free because they are still pushed, and the same poll after the pops would leave them live in registers and unrooted -- which is why this does NOT copy the landed shape at bb_suspend.cpp:36. That site is untouched and is a question for the ceo's ladder, not a change made here. ⛔⭐⭐ 11 SITES CREDITED, 17 CURED, AND THE 6-SITE GAP IS AN INSTRUMENT FALSE NEGATIVE THAT IS NAMED RATHER THAN ROUNDED AWAY: THE CENSUS CANNOT SEE A POLL THAT SERVES MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE ARMS. emit.cpp's icn_trace_tap and xa_flat.cpp's xa_icn_trace_tap are each an if/else-if chain of four allocating calls followed by ONE unconditional poll; every arm is polled at runtime and the reader credits only the LAST, because the base-predicate rule landed at ce1902895 reads the three earlier calls as having a LATER call intervening -- but an else-if arm is an ALTERNATIVE, never a successor. This is the statement-level twin of the ternary blind spot mechanized at COO-144 by _ternary_sibling_offsets, one rung up and unmechanized; the note at CEO-1109 above ALREADY RECORDS these arms as mutually exclusive while the code still treats them as successors, so the file disagreed with itself before this landing and says so now. PROVEN FROM EMITTED BYTES, NOT ARGUED: --compile on an Icon program puts call rt_gc_poll_asm exactly 7 lines after each of rt_trace_call_hook_f, rt_trace_return_hook, rt_trace_gen_fail_hook and rt_trace_fail_hook, with the guard skip label AFTER the poll so the untraced path skips it. So xa_flat 427/428/429 and emit.cpp 2912/2913/2914 are GENUINELY POLLED AND READ UNPOLLED -- a FALSE NEGATIVE, the safe direction, which convicts a cured site rather than clearing an uncured one (the mirror of CEO-1112). ⛔ THE READER IS DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED HERE: this seat holds a cure row under CEO-1124 and a reader change would raise its own number. The source-side alternative was TRIED AND MEASURED WORSE -- moving the poll into each arm takes partially_polled 0 -> 2 ("poll is guarded and the unit emits <= 2 paths") and leaves the else arm reading UNPOLLED; only the unconditional placement holds partially_polled at 0. The reader fix goes to the instruments lane after chunk C closes, on the ceo's ruling. ⛔ 4 SITES SPLIT OUT RATHER THAN FORCED, per the baton's own shape rule, as a second sub-batch with their own forms: bb_define 314 and 327 rt_ab_leave_env, declared DESCR_t with rax:rdx stored to AB_OFF_RES0/RES1 two lines later, which wants poll_res; bb_define 433 rt_define_site and 945 rt_proc_call_open_slim, both inside a scan_sync_out/scan_sync_in_rr envelope CONDITIONAL on g_scan_regs_live, with 945 declared long and live-tested by test rax,rax. ⭐ CLEARED ON THE POPULATION METHOD (the ceo's ruling that extracted standalone entries are NOT a language board and are seat-legal for every seat), never on a master board and never under S4E_ONE_RUNNER_OVERRIDE, which stayed unused: Icon 214 entries selected from ALL.csv by feature column (154 carrying suspend/return/fail/create/coexpr_activate/every_with_suspend, 60 carrying none), 204 extracted, 428 cells at stress 0 and 5 under SCRIP_GC_RELOC=1, SCRIP_HEAP_KB=128 and setarch -R against a clean-tree control on the identical set: 46 non-green on EACH arm, IDENTICAL NAME SETS, zero regressions. SNOBOL4, because emit.cpp and xa_flat.cpp and bb_define and bb_glue_flat are SHARED NODES: 210 selected (150 carrying DEFINE/APPLY/CODE/EVAL/OPSYN, 60 carrying none), 207 extracted, 420 cells, 45 non-green on EACH arm, IDENTICAL NAME SETS, zero regressions. Graded on names and never on a count, because the flake is biased toward PASS. ⭐ THE REGISTER-LIVENESS SCREEN REFUSES GLOBALLY AND WAS RUN AS AN A/B RATHER THAN QUOTED: REFUSE(2) at 88 percent decided on BOTH arms (--budget 200000 and --hops 8 do not move it; all 2283 undecided pairs are COPY and BUDGET is 0, the copy-residual refusal already handed to the ceo), with POINTER r12=19 r13=4 and all others 0 on BOTH arms while safe_points rose 3123 -> 3301. The reader can REJECT and cannot CLEAR, and it rejected NOTHING NEW across 178 added emitted safe points; that is recorded as a refusal with an unchanged reject population, NOT as a pass. preflight 59 arms 0 red.

# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-22 coo, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1119, on the coo's measured delta): safe-points. A POLL THAT FOLLOWS A LATER CALL IS THAT CALL'S SAFE POINT. The base predicate's poll window now stops at the first intervening emitted call, the stop the expansion-site window has carried since CEO-1116 -- the SAME defect one level up, held back at COO-142 because it moves the published headline and that is the ceo's call. polled 156 -> 149, unpolled 97 -> 104 on SCRIP 20424784f. ⭐ THE RISE IS THE INSTRUMENT GETTING HONEST, NOT THE TREE GETTING WORSE (ceo, CEO-1119, the CEO-935 shape): the ratchet REFUSES a rise by design, so the baseline is raised in this same landing. This SUPERSEDES the ceo's NEXT MOVE note carried below, which forecast this change -- it is history now, not a forecast. ⛔ THE MECHANICAL ARM ALONE READS 148, NOT 149, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE WHOLE POINT: a mechanical stop can NOMINATE a site and cannot CONVICT one (the symmetric half of the ceo's own law that a static reader can reject a site and cannot clear one). Sixteen first nominations, nine thrown away by hand, seven published. The ninth rejection -- bb_call_value.cpp:130, where the intervening call at :134 sits inside the ELSE arm opened at :131 -- was named at COO-143 as an unmechanized blind spot rather than rounded away, and THIS landing mechanizes it: _ternary_sibling_offsets tracks an ARM INDEX PER PAREN DEPTH, so a line in a different arm of a ternary the site also stands in is an ALTERNATIVE, never a successor. It replaces the leading-character exemption entirely -- one rule, not two -- and reproduces the hand-read name set of 104 EXACTLY, name for name, not merely the count. ⛔ TWO EARLIER SHAPES OF THAT RULE WERE WRONG AND BOTH WERE CAUGHT BY MEASURING AGAINST THE HAND-READ NAMES RATHER THAN AGAINST A COUNT: a line-granular reader re-nominated the five sites whose '?' is on their own line (bb_iterate.cpp:27/:28/:29, bb_field_get.cpp:21/:39), and a latching one CLEARED THREE the hand read convicted (bb_match_capture.cpp:124/:163, bb_rev_assign_var.cpp:19) because it read the arm the site LIVES IN as an arm the site is excluded from. Five planted selftest arms hold both directions, each proven able to go red (selftest 47 -> 52 arms). SCRIP_GC_CENSUS_BASE_CALL_STOP=0 reproduces the pre-CEO-1119 reading and was verified byte-identical on all 97 names.

The record hands rt_gc_point_arr_c ONE tagged {DT_S, slen=r15d, s=r13} cell as its shield array and the CALLER's own rsp as the floor, so the tagged cell is visited precisely and relocated while the untagged result below the floor is never swept. FAIL-ONCE, measured live with the pair in its place: a deferred LEN(*N) match under SCRIP_GC_STRESS=1 printed its captures as 0xDB poison -- a WRONG ANSWER, not a crash. NOTHING ABOUT THE CRITERION MOVED: same census, same denominator of 210; the poll spelling is the emitter helper's own name, which carries rt_gc_poll, so no --poll-helper was needed.

# ⛔ CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-18 cto, SCRIP this landing: safe-points. A TAIL JUMP IS A CALL-GRAPH EDGE, AND LEAVING IT OUT PUT 27 ALLOCATING CALL SITES OUTSIDE THE DENOMINATOR ENTIRELY -- neither polled nor counted unpolled, in the number this emergency is steered by. allocating_entries 1584 -> 1683, allocating_call_sites 210 -> 237, unpolled 97 -> 123. THE CAUSE: allocating_entries_from_binary recorded `call` edges only, and the hand-written asm allocators in src/runtime/rtx/rtx_alloc.s -- rt_str_alloc and rt_agg_alloc -- reach the carve by a TAIL JUMP (`jmp .Lga_armed` on the armed path, `je c_rt_str_alloc` to the C fallback) and never execute `call rt_gcheap_alloc`. So they, AND the 99 functions that reach the heap only through them -- the SNOBOL4 string builtins among them: DUPL_fn, REVERS_fn, SUBSTR_fn, TRIM_fn, BCHAR_fn, _CHAR_, _COLLECT_, _ITEM_ -- read NON-ALLOCATING. A tail jump IS an edge for the question this census asks: control reaches the target, the target may allocate, and it returns past us to OUR caller with the caller's frame live. objdump prints an intra-function jump as <fn+0xNN> and the symbol pattern refuses a '+', so only true inter-function transfers are recorded and a self-edge is dropped -- two new planted selftest arms hold both directions (selftest 39 -> 43 arms). ⭐ THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT GETTING HONEST, NOT A LANDING GOING BACKWARDS: the same tree, 27 sites that were never counted before, and every one of them genuinely unpolled. Found by the cto while generating the emitter's allocating table (row gc-the-emitter-emits-the-poll-not-the-template, gate test_gate_gc_the_allocating_set_is_a_generated_table_gated_against_the_call_graph.sh arm 4, which holds rt_str_alloc and rt_agg_alloc in the table by name so the narrowing cannot come back in silence).
